blockedResponse.technicalReason: Approved repair authorization was not found for the supplied approvalId.
blockedResponse.userExplanation: AfriFix execution is blocked because the required human repair approval is missing or not approved.
blockedResponse.requiredAction: Obtain valid human approval before repair execution.

globalLearning.learnedPattern: Patch verification must prove source persistence, removal of the legacy decision, canonical contract invocation, executable loading, and behavioral output.
globalLearning.reusePolicy: Every future AfriFix patch must pass structural and behavioral runtime verification before approval.
globalLearning.afriaiPolicy: AfriAI must expose structured blocked-state evidence and preserve AfriFix denial whenever verification fails.
